item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
…why go "THIS DOCUMENT IS DAMAGED" when the documents from the non-German facility would have been moved back to Germany and thus would have been damaged as well?

Uh… What? The Nazis opened Pandora's box here, man. They lost their home the same way the British lost theirs.

As far as the other complaints and commentaries are concerned: yes, this is pretty damn cliché, and yes, the other major participants in the Second World War did some pretty crazy shit. This was inspired by frustration at a lack of an Abrahamic Behemoth on the site when we already have a couple Leviathans, and the (very stupid) theoretical Landkreuzer P.1500 Monster self-propelled artillery piece. I originally wanted to skipify the idea (and I might later) but the Reimagining Contest came up, and I took advantage of it. I have no delusions that this will win the contest, and mostly wanted to get my toes in the water with WWII Foundation fiction.

If I can come up with a way to improve this after the contest, I will, and I appreciate your input, regardless of your final assessment.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
… okay.

Not enjoying it.

I mean, sorry! I didn't enjoy it! And I feel bad about it, because it's not badly written at all and, at points, it's actually a very tight piece. The problem with this is that a Tarasque-044 combo Kaiju is still not very interesting for me. Furthermore, why go "THIS DOCUMENT IS DAMAGED" when the documents from the non-German facility would have been moved back to Germany and thus would have been damaged as well? I mean, I do not get what making them damaged adds to the tale.

But… I must admit there is also an important negative bias for me here, in that I'm a bit tired of nazi science fiction. Indeed, this tale is a viable way to write about the Anherbe Obscurakorps, which would have made badass enemies of their contemporary enemies (Foundation, GRU-P, GOC founding organisations…), but I can't enjoy yet another piece of fiction where the nazis simply put a lot into one wacky school science project that, of course, either turns the war around or blows up in their little silly Kraut faces. I mean, real-world Third Reich Germany did have its moments of scientific insanity, but so did all other factions in WWII (Stalin and big tanks, anyone?). This specific trope is kinda irritating for me at this point, and it might be just me.

However, there is a proper buildup and good pacing in the letters (with the exception of the burnt sections). I'll re-read it once I've cooled the no-nazis-novelties-now-please feelings and re-check my posture. No vote til then, sorry.

item.title: AUTOR BEITRAG
item.content:encoded:
Huge thanks to Randomini, TwistedGears, and Decibelle for looking in chat, thanks to Flameshirt SoundChaser for telling me who would've succeeded Winston Churchill had Winston Churchill been blown up, and to anyone else who helped.

The lowercase on the title is intentional, don't touch it.

Spoilers
– hide block

The Australian contact? He's either cut a deal with SCP-1917, or he's cutting her into pieces in order to make this thing. Either interpretation is valid. Entity KOLOSS may or may not be a wee little thing from the Old Testament called the Behemoth. As far as what it's reimagining, it's the one or two living tank skips in Series I, and SCP-044. More reimagining the idea of Foundationverse wunderwaffe than anything.

Any questions, ask!
